name: Eliot
source:
"I'm sorry, but I can't go out with you..."

A man who looks exactly like Lily's long lost lover. However, their personalities are very different.  He has an arrogant personality and often throws harsh words at Lily. He was married, but he lost his wife five years ago.

[Translated from [url=http://mintwings.web.fc2.com/m03/character.html]official website[/url]]
